optimizedDescription.value: One graph indexes many workspaces with canonical identities, project-relative lookup, specs, and cross-workspace resolution.

optimizedContext.value:
# Workspace Integration

## Rules
- Workspace File/Document identity: `{workspaceName}:{relativeToCodeRoot}`; project-global outside all roots: `root:{projectRelativePath}`. Workspace ownership wins; never duplicate physical file as `root:`.
- `path` is canonical identity for symbols, IDs, relations. Store forward-slash `projectRelativePath` relative to active-config project root, no leading `./`, allowing `..`; denormalize onto symbols for lookup/navigation.
- Drive strings matching `^[A-Za-z]:[/\\]` or `^[A-Za-z]:$` are paths, never workspace prefixes. Applies across filtering, hotspots, storage queries, package surfaces, CLI display.
- `SymbolNode.id = {filePath}:{kind}:{name}:{line}:{column}`.
- `SpecNode.workspace` stores workspace; spec IDs remain `{workspace}:{specPath}`, respecting configured prefix.
- Discovery starts at absolute workspace `codeRoot`; `discoverFiles` returns root-relative paths and remains workspace-agnostic; indexer prefixes identity and derives project-relative path.
- Unprefixed CLI/tool file selectors may exact-match `projectRelativePath`; canonical identity remains authoritative.
- Specs come exclusively from workspace `SpecRepository`: list identities, persisted-state hash, artifact content (`spec.md` first then alphabetical; no metadata/locks), metadata defaults, persisted dependencies and implementation. No CLI precompute/filesystem fallback.
- Pass 2 sees all workspace symbols. Relative import stays workspace; package import uses adapter-derived package→workspace map; PHP qualified names resolve globally.
- Cross-workspace identity is structured workspace/module-package/public-surface/symbol-space. Apply language case, visibility, supported config. Never infer target from global same-name match.
- Workspace roots/package identities/project references/autoload mappings/deterministic resolution inputs affect derivation fingerprint.
- Exact file selectors normalize canonical, project-relative, and absolute spellings to one file. Wildcards retain pattern semantics.
- `IndexOptions`: project root, `ProjectWorkspace[]`, project graph config, optional progress/chunk/ref, explicit `vcsRoot: string|null`. Graph config carries global includes/excludes and per-workspace allowed/excluded paths/`respectGitignore`.
- Indexer obtains repository from `ProjectWorkspace`; removed `WorkspaceIndexTarget.specs` callback.
- `IndexResult.workspaces` reports per-workspace discovered/indexed/skipped/removed files and discovered/indexed specs.
- `respectGitignore` default true: with supplied VCS root, load root+nested files relative to location; gitignore exclusions absolute. Null root means no probing. False means only explicit exclusion rules.

## Constraints
- Runtime dependency on `@specd/core`.
- One project graph store.
- Discovery workspace-agnostic; indexer owns identities/project-relative paths.
- Spec access only through `SpecRepository`.
- Identity metadata migrations such as `configRelativePath`→`projectRelativePath` require full rebuild.
